name: Atlassian (Jira & Confluence)
description: Search Jira issues, manage tickets, and read Confluence pages from your agent.
installHint: Atlassian Cloud: paste your site URL, account email and API token. Server/Data Center: paste your site URL and a personal access token instead. Jira and Confluence are configured separately; omit the one you don't use. The mcp-atlassian package runs via uvx - no install needed.

envFields.label: Jira URL
envFields.helperText: Your Jira base URL (Cloud or Server/Data Center). Omit if using Confluence only.

envFields.label: Jira username (email) - Cloud
envFields.helperText: Atlassian Cloud only. Email address linked to your Atlassian account.

envFields.label: Jira API token - Cloud
envFields.helperText: Atlassian Cloud only. Required with the username when JIRA_URL is a Cloud site.

envFields.label: Jira personal access token - Server/Data Center
envFields.helperText: Server/Data Center only. Use instead of the username and API token.

envFields.label: Confluence URL
envFields.helperText: Your Confluence base URL (Cloud or Server/Data Center). Omit if using Jira only.

envFields.label: Confluence username (email) - Cloud
envFields.helperText: Atlassian Cloud only. Email address linked to your Atlassian account.

envFields.label: Confluence API token - Cloud
envFields.helperText: Atlassian Cloud only. Required with the username when CONFLUENCE_URL is a Cloud site.

envFields.label: Confluence personal access token - Server/Data Center
envFields.helperText: Server/Data Center only. Use instead of the username and API token.
